construction.implementation_origin: Original isolated implementation with explicitly synthetic retail fixtures

shared_schema.input: Strict top-level object: schema_version, synthetic, catalog, customer, basket, feedback, clickstream, preferences, documents, extraction_schema, knowledge_base, question.
shared_schema.catalog: JSON feed: unique SKU, name, numeric nonnegative price, integer stock, single currency, string attributes.
shared_schema.customer: Synthetic id and persona, explicit boolean GDPR and CCPA consent.
shared_schema.basket: Order ID, matching customer ID, unique SKU items and positive quantities no larger than catalog stock.
shared_schema.clickstream: JSON event-log array: customer_id, SKU, event=view|add_to_basket.
shared_schema.envelope: schema_version, status, synthetic, input (source context), stages (ordered feedback, compare, extract, faq). Errors instead return status=error and error text.
shared_schema.validation: One shared validate_state/validate_input layer runs before and after every stage; it checks context integrity, consent, catalog facts, handoff order and source provenance.
shared_schema.extraction: Fields define name, literal label, string|number|integer type, required boolean. Reserved context field types are fixed. Source spans are zero-based Python Unicode character offsets with exclusive ends.
shared_schema.knowledge_base: Source articles: unique id, optional SKU scope, text and structured price/stock claims checked against catalog. Numeric commercial answers use catalog_facts, not generated prose.

cross_stage_handoffs: feedback -> compare: deduplicated theme evidence counts influence consented budget scoring; excerpts remain exact source text.
compare -> extract: selected SKU chooses the document; extracted commercial and customer/order fields must match shared context.
extract -> faq: validated extracted SKU gates SKU-scoped retrieval; missing SKU explicitly abstains; catalog facts always use selected catalog row.

behavior.feedback: Case, punctuation and whitespace insensitive deduplication within each SKU; all original source IDs retained; fixed whole-word theme dictionaries; full original supporting excerpts.
behavior.comparison: Capacity L/ml normalization and grey/gray normalization; side-by-side rows sorted by score then SKU. Soft ranking: budget +3 plus capped price-theme count, availability +4, each matching attribute +2, clickstream contribution capped at +3. Not a hard filter.
behavior.consent: Both explicit GDPR and CCPA consent flags must be true before preferences, clickstream or feedback-derived personalization are scored; otherwise neutral SKU order. Demonstrative rules, not a legal compliance certification.
behavior.extraction: Literal case-insensitive line-label matching, deterministic type conversion, exact spans; duplicate document labels or context contradictions fail validation. Missing required and optional fields are separately reported.
behavior.faq: Conservative exact-token coverage after stopword removal; all substantive query tokens must occur in one eligible article. Stable source-ID tie-break; verbatim article answer and citations only. No match or missing extracted SKU yields explicit abstention. Always supplies catalog-authoritative price and stock separately.
behavior.reviews: No generated reviews or endorsements; every feedback excerpt is traceable to a clearly labeled synthetic source.
behavior.cli: Exactly one JSON object to stdout; success exit 0, file/JSON/schema errors exit 2. Duplicate JSON keys rejected; no live model or optional provider used.

included: Synthetic catalog, shopper and order fixtures
excluded: Semantic entailment or unrestricted natural-language extraction

coverage: Schema-driven extraction with LF/CRLF source spans
